description: Japanese Navy fighter recovered from Bougainville at the end of the Second World War, flown north to RNZAF Station H12 and shipped to New Zealand. Displayed in its own gallery; the museum's own material notes the airframe is a composite involving airframes 3835 and 3844.
Late-production Spitfire that never flew in combat, presented to the people of New Zealand by Britain after the Second World War. Displayed marked RAB-J.
German V-1 flying bomb displayed in the museum's Second World War galleries.
